display_name: Read and optionally price a session usage window
description: Calls session_ledger_service.session_usage_totals once with since, until and vendor unchanged. With priced absent or false, returns the exact S1 dictionary and adds no metadata. With priced=true, preserves all S1 fields and adds pricing_by_model with USD and basis, unpriced_token_count and sorted unpriced_models. Pricing uses the windowed by_model totals and the agent_messaging_plugin S2 pricing helpers. Partial, bounded and truncated S1 status/advisories remain visible. Unknown models remain in the response and are counted as unpriced; no fallback price is inferred. Session identity arguments are not accepted. Read-only.
embedding_description: Reads session ledger token totals for the requested since, until and vendor window and can add catalog-priced USD and basis by model. Raw mode preserves the S1 response exactly; priced mode keeps unknown models and unpriced-token counts. Both retain bounded, partial or truncated status and advisories, and the call accepts no unit or runtime identity.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: The raw S1 response unchanged when priced is absent/false; priced mode preserves those fields and adds pricing_by_model, unpriced_token_count and unpriced_models.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Keep S1 completeness status and advisories with the token totals. When priced, distinguish priced USD from known unpriced tokens, name the per-model basis, and state that the USD is a catalog estimate. Do not claim unknown model usage is free or complete when S1 reports partial/bounded data.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Pass since, until and vendor unchanged to S1. Set priced=true only when USD estimates are wanted. Leave runtime_session_ids, unit_id and agent_instance_id out of this window call.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: One read-only S1 window request, followed by in-memory S2 pricing only when priced=true. No persisted pricing cache or writes.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: S1 parameter_invalid caller errors pass through unchanged. A missing ledger service returns status unknown with ledger_service_unavailable. Missing or ambiguous pricing returns null USD with an unpriced basis and a known-token count.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Correct the S1 since/until/vendor arguments when its caller error is returned. Keep raw mode for token-only reporting. Inspect advisories for bounded data or lower-bound unpriced token counts.
